description: yggdrasil's shared Renovate preset. A repository extends it with renovate.json: {"extends": ["local>artur-rios/yggdrasil//renovate/default"]}. It covers what each repository's dependabot.yml covered (nuget, npm, github-actions, docker), and the pinned images of yggdrasil.yml, and the tools pinned in check scripts and Dockerfiles with a `# renovate:` comment. It targets develop; a repository on main or master overrides baseBranchPatterns in its own renovate.json.

packageRules.description: Packages that are released together and must move together, as Dependabot grouped them.
NuGet and npm updates weekly, as Dependabot did.
Actions and images monthly. The images of yggdrasil.yml and the Dockerfiles are pinned by digest, and the owner merges the change to yggdrasil.yml (a protected file on develop).
schedule: on the first day of the month

customManagers.description: The images pinned by version and digest in yggdrasil.yml: `image: <name>:<tag>@sha256:<digest>`, quoted or not, in a check, in release.build and validate, and in publish.nuget.

A tool pinned by a variable in a check script or a Dockerfile, with a `# renovate: datasource=<datasource> depName=<name>` comment (optionally ` versioning=<versioning>`) on the line above: `NAME=1.2.3`, `NAME="1.2.3"`, `ARG NAME=1.2.3` or `ENV NAME=1.2.3`. A checksum next to the version is the repository's to update with it.
